Dear Sakari and Markus,
After discussing again with EcoG, they requested us to keep troubleshooting for hardware issues other than the Ecog device. As for your feedback, replacing the Ethernet cable and changing the connection on a different switch port doesn't seems to make any difference.
We will replace the affected Ecog by a functional one in a different charger to try to identify if the issue remains on the Ecog device or not.
I want to thank you for your cooperation and support handling this topic.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0429034 - ID0429034-DC/Si-D/FI-DC1 not working CRM:00472000322
additional_info.body:
Hi,
Seems like this issue is fixed after my site visit a couple weeks ago. I cross-exhanged KF12 with charger rI01JZ and both are working normally now. I changed the ethernet cable and network switch port to another free slot.
Markus
